svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

metadata.orrery:spec: # yaml-language-server: $schema=../references/diagram.schema.json title: Web app on Azure subtitle: Front Door sends traffic to App Service, which reaches Azure SQL and Key Vault through private endpoints direction: down # Filled triangles, as in Azure's reference diagrams; one port per edge. arrowhead: filled layout: { merge: false } legend: solid: Request traffic dotted: Telemetry groups: sub: { type: azure:subscription, label: Production subscription } rg: { type: azure:resource-group, label: rg-web-prod, in: sub } # cols: 2 puts the integration subnet and the private endpoint subnet side by side. vnet: { type: azure:vnet, label: vnet-web-prod 10.20.0.0/16, in: rg, cols: 2 } snet-app: { type: azure:subnet, label: snet-app-integration, in: vnet } snet-pe: { type: azure:subnet, label: snet-pe, in: vnet } nodes: users: { icon: azure:users, label: Users } fd: { icon: azure:front-door, label: Azure Front Door, note: WAF policy, in: rg } # App Service is a PaaS service outside the VNet; only its integration interface sits in the subnet. # align puts Front Door, App Service and Application Insights in one row above the VNet. app: { icon: azure:app-service, label: App Service, note: Web app, align: fd, in: rg } vnet-int: { icon: azure:network-interfaces, label: Integration interface, note: "VNet integration, outbound only", in: snet-app } pe-sql: { icon: azure:private-endpoint, label: Private endpoint, note: SQL Database, in: snet-pe } pe-kv: { icon: azure:private-endpoint, label: Private endpoint, note: Key Vault, in: snet-pe } # Private DNS zones make App Service resolve the private endpoints instead of the public ones. # Listed first of the services so the zones sit under the integration interface. dns: { icon: azure:dns-zones, label: Private DNS zones, note: privatelink zones, in: rg } sql: { icon: azure:sql, label: Azure SQL Database, in: rg } kv: { icon: azure:key-vault, label: Key Vault, note: Connection secrets, in: rg } insights: { icon: azure:app-insights, label: Application Insights, note: Telemetry, align: fd, in: rg } edges: - users -> fd: HTTPS - fd -> app - app -> vnet-int - vnet-int -> pe-sql: TCP 1433 - pe-sql -> sql: Private Link - vnet-int -> pe-kv: HTTPS - pe-kv -> kv: Private Link - vnet-int -> dns: name resolution - app ..> insights

svg.title: Web app on Azure
svg.desc: Web app on Azure. 10 components in 5 groups. Connections: Users to Azure Front Door (HTTPS); Azure Front Door to App Service; App Service to Integration interface; Integration interface to Private endpoint (TCP 1433); Private endpoint to Azure SQL Database (Private Link); Integration interface to Private endpoint (HTTPS); Private endpoint to Key Vault (Private Link); Integration interface to Private DNS zones (name resolution); App Service to Application Insights.

text.tspan: Front Door sends traffic to App Service, which reaches Azure SQL and Key Vault through private endpoints
